p: One of the few zamindar palaces in South Kolkata, built by Joynarayan Ghosal in 1781. He had an estate at Gobindapur, which later became Fort William (present-day Vijay Durg). He got a new estate of 108 bighas (1,44,720 m²) at…
One of the major Jagannath temples in West Bengal, and Ratha Yatra is the major crowd-puller of this temple.
